description: Source code for TunerStudio IO interface, handling serial/USB communication, DMA buffers, and data transmission for engine tuning software.

methods.name: startTsPort
methods.description: Initializes and starts the TunerStudio communication port over USB or serial, depending on configuration.

methods.name: stopTsPort
methods.description: Stops the TunerStudio communication port if applicable.

methods.name: sr5WriteData
methods.description: Sends data over the TunerStudio port, using DMA or serial depending on configuration.

methods.name: sr5ReadDataTimeout
methods.description: Reads data with a timeout from the TunerStudio port buffer.

methods.name: sr5ReadData
methods.description: Reads data with default timeout from the TunerStudio port buffer.

methods.name: sr5WriteCrcPacket
methods.description: Constructs and sends a packet with CRC for data integrity.

methods.name: sr5SendResponse
methods.description: Sends a response over the port, optionally with CRC.

methods.name: sr5IsReady
methods.description: Checks if the TunerStudio port is ready for communication.
